$comment: Source of truth for every property photo. Originals live untouched in assets/originals/. Run `npm run images` to regenerate web versions in public/images/. Every entry was classified by looking at the photo itself, not the filename. focal = where the camera should push toward, in % of width/height.

images.title: The building on C Street
images.alt: Two-story red brick building with arched upper windows and a teal scalloped awning over the storefront; the windows carry Soozeezbeez Beetique bee decals.
images.notes: Front facade, street level. Shows the original Soozeezbeez Beetique window decals (authentic signage, do not alter). Upstairs arched windows are the rental. A framed photo sits inside the shop door; it may be of Susi, and it must not be cropped or used without family approval.

images.title: The corner and the flower mural
images.alt: Low-angle view of the brick corner building with a tall painted mural of pink coneflowers on a golden sky and the teal awning wrapping the storefront.
images.notes: Strongest establishing shot: strong perspective lines, warm light, botanical mural that fits the bee story. Neighbouring 'Springfield Mercantile Co.' sign visible (a location clue, not confirmed).

images.title: From the alley
images.alt: Rear of the brick building from a walking path, showing the upstairs deck with a tan umbrella, metal stairs and a white door marked 320.
images.notes: Shows how the upstairs deck sits on the building. Good bridge from exterior to the deck shots. Walking path has a painted red line.

images.title: The private deck
images.alt: Sunny upstairs deck with a wicker loveseat, glass coffee table, patterned outdoor rug and a tan patio umbrella, looking over the street and neighbouring brick buildings.
images.notes: Bright, open, and good for a slow lateral move. Overlaps with deck-entry, which shows the same furniture from the opposite side.

images.title: Deck and private entry
images.alt: Wicker sectional and glass table on the deck beside the brick wall and a white entry door with an arched transom window.
images.notes: The entry door is marked with a unit number. This is the only photo of a guest entrance, so it is the honest 'arrival' beat. Reverse angle of deck-view.

images.title: The living room in daylight
images.alt: Bright living room with a curved grey tufted sofa, round ottoman and floral rug on original hardwood floors, under exposed beams, silver ductwork and three tall windows.
images.notes: Hero interior. Pairs with living-evening (same camera position, curtains closed, string lights on), which allows a true day-to-night dissolve with no invented geometry.

images.title: The living room at evening
images.alt: The same living room with curtains drawn and warm string lights glowing on branch decor, a 'Bee Our Guest' sign and honeycomb shelves on the ivy-draped wall.
images.notes: Nearly the same camera position as living-daylight, so the day-to-night dissolve lines up without warping.

images.title: Arches, ivy and honeycomb
images.alt: Living room looking toward a white arched doorway and the hallway, with honeycomb shelves, a 'Bee Our Guest' sign and cascading ivy on the sage wall.
images.notes: Reverse angle of the living room. Shows bee pillows and the arch that leads to the hall.

images.title: Exposed brick and fireplace
images.alt: Exposed red brick wall with a wall-mounted TV over an electric fireplace console, brass sconces and timber beams, beside an arched doorway.
images.notes: Architectural detail: original brick, beams, arch. The fireplace is an electric unit in a media console.

images.title: Dining and workspace
images.alt: Desk with a bench and chair beside a dining table near two tall windows, under a glowing 'Bee Our Guest' neon sign and trailing ivy.
images.notes: Shows the desk and dining table. The neon 'Bee Our Guest' sign is a good signature detail for a close push.

images.title: The kitchen
images.alt: L-shaped kitchen with warm maple shaker cabinets, concrete-look counters, stainless sink and dishwasher, fern garland above the cabinets and a small beehive figurine.
images.notes: Only kitchen photo. A stove and refrigerator are not visible, so do not list them.

images.title: Bedroom
images.alt: Bedroom with a white carved bed and grey tufted headboard, navy throw, bee-print pillows and a floral rug with a large bee motif, beside a tall window.
images.notes: May be the same room as bedroom-dresser, or a second bedroom with matching furniture. Bedroom count is unconfirmed.

images.title: Bedroom details
images.alt: Bed with bee-embroidered pillows facing a white dresser and arched mirror with trailing plants and brass lamps; a doorway shows patterned tile beyond.
images.notes: Shows a small bee plush and bee-themed decor. Bed size and count are unconfirmed.

images.title: The bathroom
images.alt: Sage bathroom with a backlit oval mirror, dark wood vanity, hexagon honeycomb shelves with small plants, a bee hand towel and a ruffled cream shower curtain.
images.notes: Only bathroom photo. Shower or tub type is not visible behind the curtain.

images.title: The hallway
images.alt: Long hallway with original pine floorboards, a partly exposed brick wall and a cage sconce, leading through an arched doorway to the bright living room.
images.notes: Portrait. Strong one-point perspective, which makes it the best candidate for a forward 'dolly' push. Use it to link the bedroom and living spaces.

derived.alt: The original Soozeezbeez Beetique window decal: a honeybee framed by flowers and a banner, as it appears on the storefront glass.
derived.notes: Plain crop of the real storefront photo. No retouching or redrawing.

reconstruction.summary: Not enough coverage for honest 3D reconstruction or a 360 tour. The photos are single wide-angle real-estate frames, about 1 to 4 per space, and most walls are unseen.
overlapping_pairs: near-identical viewpoint; use for day/night dissolve, not 3D
opposite ends of one room; too little overlap for photogrammetry
reverse angles of the same furniture; partial overlap
